summary: The root نقع (nqE) primarily describes water that collects and stagnates, often changing in color or quality.
lane: 1 نَقَعَ ذ and It (water) remained, or stagnated, or collected, in a hollow, or cavity: (Mgh:) or remained long, and became altered: (Msb:) or the former [and latter] collected in a مَنْقَع : (S:) or the latter [and former] became yellow and altered. (K.) -b2- نَقَعَ and [ He macerated, steeped, or soaked, a medicine, in water, ] he left it in water until its colour became changed. (Msb.)

headwords.gloss: An infusion; a beverage made by steeping something in water; a mash

parts.t: a beverage made by steeping something in water:

headwords.def: نَقِيعٌ An infusion; meaning, a beverage made by steeping something in water: (Msb:) and a mash.

headwords.gloss: Poison that takes effect; that kills; that remains fixed
headwords.def: سَمٌّ نَاقِعٌ Poison that takes effect; (S, K;) that kills: (TA:) that remains fixed, (Abu-nNasr, K, TA,) and collects. (Abu-Nasr, TA.)
أَنْقَعُ More, or most, thirst-quenching: see an ex. under الحَاذُ , in art. حوذ ; and another voce رَشَفَ .

headwords.gloss: hollow; depression, of; in which the gravy collects
headwords.def: أَنْقُوعَةٌ The hollow, or depression, of ثَرِيد , (S, A, K,) in which the gravy collects. (A, K. *)

headwords.gloss: A place where water remains and collects; where it collects and stagnates; where it remains long, and becomes altered

parts.t: A place where water remains and collects; where it collects and stagnates;
where it remains long, and becomes altered.

headwords.def: مَنْقَعُ مَآءِ , and مَآءٍ , A place where water remains and collects; where it collects and stagnates; or where it remains long, and becomes altered. See نَقَعَ .
